WRITE · TRACE · DRAW

A little practice, at your pace.

Try together with a grown-up. Use the writing space below, or copy the same prompt into a notebook.

A LITTLE PRACTICE, A LOT OF POSSIBILITY

Your very own writing space.

Trace a letter, practise your name, or fill the page with ideas. Choose a colour and write with your finger, stylus or mouse.

TRY IT
RIGHT HERE
Pen colour

Start at the top. Down one side, down the other, then across.

Use paper and a pencil to follow the practice prompt.

Ready when you are. There is no score—just room to practise.

Writing stays on this device and disappears when you refresh or close the page. Save your picture to keep it. Changing the activity starts a new page; Undo restores the previous marks. Prefer paper? Copy the prompt into a notebook and draw there.

Start small.

Choose one letter or number and practise for a few minutes. Model it slowly, then invite your child to try. Use Undo freely: this is exploration, not a score or a handwriting assessment.

Make it comfortable.

Rest the device on a stable surface. A fingertip works; a stylus is optional. Try a thicker line and a larger movement if fine movements are difficult. Paper and crayons are always a good alternative. Download the printable handwriting sheet.

Keep what you make.

Save your page as a PNG image before closing or refreshing. Nothing you draw is sent to us or stored online. Clear and activity changes can be undone during this visit.
